message: スーパーハッカーナナカ！

name: Lolotte
message: 「The paperwork, the paperwork won't go down! Please do something!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte. Pass some over to me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Take it all and run, right!」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't dump all of it on him, okay?\s02」
General attendance doubled compared to last year.
A venue setup completely different from last year.
Between this and that, the workload has doubled.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Send some of that my way too, won't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry about this. You're not even an officer...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Don't mind it at all. I helped out a little last year too, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「My side's all wrapped up! All that's left is having Helena-san check it over.」

name: Synn
message: 「Jangara!」

name: Jangara
message: 「Ee.」

name: Synn
message: 「Take this over to Helena-san, and here, a little treat for your trouble.」

name: Jangara
message: 「Ee!」
Following up from KiraFes, we also have the Delicious Food Squad helping us out, and
seeing how swamped we were, even Misasagi-senpai volunteered to lend a hand.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Going by this, aren't we short on stoves?」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's see... one, two, three--you're right. Even though they're properly accounted for in the budget...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Um... could it be this? This number right here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, a 3 got turned into an 8--that's what threw it off.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As expected of my best friend. I'm so proud of you.」
Even someone like her got roped into this.

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry for pulling you in so suddenly.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It's fine. I don't get much experience with this sort of thing, so it's fun.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Everyone, keep at it~」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa, that's a ton! Good luck!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You guys are so irresponsible.」

name: Misa
message: 「You two help out with something, too!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Leave it to me~」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll take on any challenge from anyone!」

name: Misa
message: 「N-Never mind. You two just stay over there and cheer us on.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Smart move.」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, I know! I'll treat everyone to some juice I got from Demon World Mail-Order! 'Gush-Drip-Oozing-Blood'」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sounds kinda amazing~ Like blood's gonna come gushing and dripping right out~.」

name: Sally
message: 「They say it's so good that blood'll spray out of your whole body! Not that I'm gonna drink any!」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'll go make some tea.\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Something wrong, Nanaka?」
Nanaka turned the laptop toward me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Azel's already finished taking photos of all the students, and she's even finished picking out the ones for the display.」

name: Synn
message: 「...You're right.」
The contents were sorted into folders by class, and each individual file was labeled with the student's grade, class, and name.
The KiraFes data was stored all together in a separate folder.
And in a folder titled "Daily Life," snapshots of casual moments from school life had been collected.

name: Misa
message: 「Wait... wasn't that password-protected?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uh, well, I was fiddling around with it a bit and it just opened.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So Treasurer-san was a villain all along!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whaaat?! Nana-chan was a bad guy~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey... have some faith in your friend!」

name: Sally
message: 「That's a dine-and-dash!」

name: Misa
message: 「Look who's talking.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte, it is rude to jump to conclusions before any evidence turns up.」
Could it be.
Did Azel intend to hide herself from the very beginning.
Is that why she was taking photos in such a hurry?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Someone who steals passwords is an arsonist! They start fires!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Don'tcha mean a hacker?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even so, since you went to the trouble of stealing it, please tell us.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, no, well, Azel might get embarrassed if people find out, so everyone just pretend you didn't see it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm-hmm. So it is an embarrassing word.」

name: Paqy
message: 「At least tell Synn-sama.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I... might not be able to tell Synn.」

name: Misa
message: 「Really? Why?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Umm... no comment.」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, I wonder how she figured it out?」

name: Misa
message: 「Maybe the password was her birthday or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, when is Azel's birthday, anyway?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't even know!? *Sigh*, this is why dense guys are hopeless.」
Come to think of it... I don't know her birthday or her blood type.
I don't even know what kind of life she lived before coming here.

name: Lolotte
message: 「On a birthday, one simply must gaze at the night view from the top-floor suite of a luxury hotel.」

name: Misa
message: 「How romantic...\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Wait, how shameless! That's completely inappropriate!」

name: Synn
message: 「The rooftop of some tall building around here is probably the best I could do...」

name: Ria
message: 「That'd be freezing at this time of year.\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, did you know Azel's birthday?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I didn't.」

name: Misa
message: 「Then how did you figure it out? You wouldn't know just by typing things in at random, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Uhm... woman's intuition, maybe?」
Nanaka looked over at me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, Azel's gonna come back anyway, so it was totally unnecessary!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Back to work, back to work!」

name: Melilot
message: 「She hasn't come in.」

name: Synn
message: 「I... see.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, and I also have one favor to ask today.」

name: Melilot
message: 「What might that be?」

name: Synn
message: 「Could you let me see Azel's library card?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I cannot simply show you records pertaining to an individual's privacy without permission.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're aware that Azel is missing, aren't you.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am aware.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why I want any kind of clue I can get.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please wait a moment.」
Melilot-san flipped through the library cards.

name: Melilot
message: 「It isn't here.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Could it be that she secretly took it out and disposed of it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Right under your nose, Melilot-san?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes.」
It's unlike her.
It's unlike Melilot-san, who is the master of the library and said to keep track of every single book.

name: Synn
message: 「When do you think she took it out?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well... I'm afraid I wouldn't know.」
I couldn't read anything from her expression.

name: Synn
message: 「What about the computer records?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Go right ahead.」
Melilot-san turned the monitor toward me.
There are no records after her disappearance.
However.
A library card is filled out before borrowing--meaning before it's entered into the computer.
Knowing how overly earnest and inflexible Azel is, she would have forgotten her current situation and dutifully gone through the procedure.
If that's the case, she couldn't afford to show me a card with a date written on it from after her disappearance.
It's pure speculation, but if I'm right, it means Azel came here after she vanished.
And Melilot-san is hiding that fact.
Probably because she believes keeping it hidden is for Azel's sake.

name: Synn
message: 「...I'm a little relieved.」

name: Melilot
message: 「About what?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if the card was lost, as long as the records remain on the computer, you can easily make a new one, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Perhaps I carelessly put it away somewhere else. I'll look for it. If that's what happened, I think it should turn up by the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll leave it to you.」

name: Melilot
message: 「You've gotten quite efficient at this.」

name: Azel
message: 「Y-You think so?」
Melilot handed a library card to Azel, who had been organizing books.

name: Melilot
message: 「Please hold onto this.」

name: Azel
message: 「What's this about?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Just a moment ago, Sakura-kun asked me to show him this.」

name: Azel
message: 「You should have shown him. There's no problem.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san, you press down very hard when you write. Even after erasing it, what you wrote the day before yesterday is still clearly visible.」

name: Melilot
message: 「For the time being, I told them it was lost, though.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Synn is no fool.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, I'm coming in.」
I unlock the door with the spare key.
It was my second time entering Azel's room.

name: Synn
message: 「There really isn't anything here...」
A bleak, bare room, just as before.
From the looks of it, her uniform was still there, but her everyday clothes were gone.

name: Synn
message: 「For all she said about it... she actually liked it.」
In the corner of the room sat her Leica and several rolls of spare film.

name: Synn
message: 「She even left her Leica behind.」
Her futon was neatly put away, too.
I only took a quick glance, but it seemed like her underwear had dwindled as well.
She'd walked out taking only her everyday clothes and underwear.
The premonition that Azel wouldn't come back grew stronger. I couldn't shake it.
I tried looking for anything that might tell me where she went, but the trash can was empty.
The small desk drawer was empty too. Even if I wanted to look for books, there wasn't a bookshelf.
With no furniture, there wasn't anything lying behind a cabinet or table either.
There wasn't a single clue pointing to her destination.
If this were one of those TV suspense dramas Nanaka gives me the synopses for,

name: Synn
message: 「There'd be a timetable, a map, or a train ticket lying around--casually, yet conspicuously.」
The handful of photos taped to the wall hadn't changed since last time either.
They were everyday snapshots of the academy and Ryuusei Town.
I hadn't looked closely enough last time to notice, but I could feel Azel's warm gaze through these photos.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? This photo...」
This wasn't here last time.
No, maybe it was, and I just hadn't noticed.
It was a photograph of cat-like Demons.
Though they were squinting against the flash, they were captured in the frame without a hint of tension.
One was facing the camera and winking, and there was even one looking straight into the lens.
It didn't look like the flash had been fired to drive them away.
They were properly photographed as subjects.
Once before, Demons had fled in fright at the burst of a camera flash.
Yet here, they hadn't run away.
Which meant this had to have been taken after that night.
A candid shot?
No. That's not it.
Firing a flash would give away her location immediately.
And on top of that, the Demons weren't in a panic.
If they had been targeting Azel, they would have attacked right away.
However, I've never heard Azel say anything about being attacked.
In the first place, even if these were taken secretly...
It's weird that some of them are winking or even looking straight at the camera.

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think Azel... was actually on good terms with those Demons?」
Did we just misunderstand things when we thought Azel was being attacked?

name: Synn
message: 「...No, it's dangerous to jump to conclusions from just a single photo...」
I took another close look at the photos.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh... this is.」
It was a photo of Pasta.
With dark trees at night in the background, Pasta is flashing a V-sign with a huge smile.
Something feels off.
I'd seen Azel and Pasta talking at Prier a few times before.
So if the background were the academy during the day or evening, it wouldn't be strange.
But this is at night.
On top of that, Pasta isn't wearing the clothes from working at Prier.
It's the outfit from when we were fighting.
Did they just happen to run into each other late at night and take this?
